topic: Working hours visibility settings for inventory
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the implementation and default visibility of 'working hours' settings within the Inventory module.

*   **Scope:** The setting will initially be available only on Beta and Staging environments.
*   **Pro-vanotage (Провантаж):** For this specific client/project, the working hours option must be visible but defaulted to **OFF**. 
*   **Other Clients:** For all other clients, the working hours option should not be shown at all. The setting is currently available on Staging for Pro-vanotage, and it is correctly set to default OFF.

Additionally, visibility cone calculations were confirmed as functional (max distance recalculates if width & height are present; min distance recalculates if height & height from ground & height > 3).
decisions: Working hours setting will be visible but defaulted to OFF for Pro-vanotage on Beta/Staging.
The working hours option should not be shown for any other client.
